subject: Why Weight Loss Drugs Prevent Cognitive Decline Yet Fail Against Alzheimer's
script: From Agewell Brief: Why Weight Loss Drugs Prevent Cognitive Decline Yet Fail Against Alzheimer's. Blockbuster metabolic therapies alter cerebral biomarkers and lower dementia risk in observational data, yet fail to slow established Alzheimer's disease. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
